_doc: Emerald-only story objects of chapter 12 (emerald_ch12_13, 2026-10-12; format: b2tools/patches/story.py): the Island Cave's lap (Emerald's Regice puzzle, src/field_scripts/emerald/0254_room_IslandCave.s): a step trigger on each of the 36 tiles along the wall (pokeemerald src/braille_puzzles.c sRegicePathCoords, in order: scripts 7-42) and three over the floor inside the lap (script 6), all firing only while the zone-local work 0x4001 (IC_STATE) is 1, i.e. after the braille was read. Room tiles = pokeemerald's (the room's origin is (0,0)). The side braille signs (ch12.json, script 4) mark lap tile 3 or 5 by where the player stands. The Desert Ruins' Rock Smash spot is ch12.json's Strength trigger moved (at_emerald).
